title: Luna's Simple Bricks
description: A resource pack that changes the textures for minecraft bricks!
body:
This resource pack makes Minecraft’s brick textures more consistent and simple while staying close to the original vanilla style. The goal is to improve consistency across brick-related blocks, making them look cleaner and more uniform without changing their overall feel. Changes are minimal, so builds still look and feel like vanilla.

# Installation
1. Open Minecraft
2. Go to **Options -> Resource Packs**
3. Drag the .zip file into the window **or** click "**Open Pack Folder**" and place it there
4. Enable the pack in-game
